subject: Custody ceremony logistics and audit-ready evidence plan
messages:
From: Alex Navarro <alex@stratushealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@stratushealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: KMS custody ceremony — evidence we need before cutover

Marcus —

Thanks again for yesterday's run-through. Stratus is moving toward the on-prem cutover the week of July 12 and our audit team needs a clear list of what evidence Redwood will provide from the custody ceremony and operator handoff. High level asks from compliance:

- Signed operator attendance log
- PKCS#11 attestation output or HSM firmware snapshot
- Timestamped key generation/transfer receipts and the WAL/manifest file
- Proof we rotated KEKs after split custody (if applicable)

Can you confirm what Redwood can export automatically, and what we need to generate on our side? Also please include the recommended sequence for the ceremony (who mints, who verifies, whether we can do a dry run).

I can loop in our security engineer if needed, but first we need a short scope doc and a one-hour dry-run slot.

— Alex
Principal Security Engineer
Stratus Health
(attachment: initial-evidence-ask.txt)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>
To: Alex Navarro <alex@stratushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>
Date: 2027-06-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS custody ceremony — evidence we need before cutover

Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front:

- We can produce an operator attendance log (signed by each operator email) as a PDF and a machine-readable CSV.
- We can export HSM attestation material (quote + firmware digest) where the HSM supports remote attestation; otherwise we provide a signed local attestation bundle.
- Key generation/transfer receipts and the manifest (WAL) are exportable from our private control plane; we'll timestamp and include the signing keys used to seal the receipt.
- We support KEK rotation and will include rotation proofs (signed sequence of KEK versions).

I'll attach a short draft scope (custody-checklist.pdf) and a proposed ceremony order. Quick call? We recommend:

1) Pre-check (network, NTP, HSM connectivity)
2) Operator identity verification and attendance log
3) Key generation / wrap / transfer step with live checksums
4) KEK rotation and seal step
5) Evidence bundle assembly and signed closure

Dry run: we can do a one-hour dry run the week of July 5 — propose Tue/Wed mornings PST.

Cc'ing Marissa for operation-level runbook and Laura for audit/PO approval notes.

— Marcus
Director, Customer Deployments
Redwood Inference
(attachment: custody-checklist.pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>
To: Alex Navarro <alex@stratushealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example>
Date: 2027-06-21T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS custody ceremony — evidence we need before cutover

Alex / team —

Appreciate the clarity. A few policy notes from the audit perspective so we bake them into the evidence package:

- Redwood will sign the operator attendance log with the deployment manager's signing key; we will include operator PGP fingerprints if the customer requires an external signature check.
- For HSM attestation, we'll provide the quote and the route for independent verification (vendor attestation URL + firmware digest). If the HSM is air-gapped, we'll do a signed bundle and include a checksum file.
- All timestamps will be ISO-8601 with timezone; our export includes event_id and SHA256 checksums for each artifact.
- We will keep the evidence package in the customer's Drive folder (link below) and push a copy to the Redwood secure retention bucket for 90 days unless the customer requests longer retention.

Please confirm retention window and whether Stratus wants us to notarize the package (DocuSign closure or equivalent).

Also, Marissa/Tessa — can you provide the dry-run invite grid and annotate which steps are automated vs manual? We should mark the manual check-points for Stratus operators.

Thanks,
Laura
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
(related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeF-client-evidence)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
To: Alex Navarro <alex@stratushealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example>
Date: 2027-06-22T16:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS custody ceremony — evidence we need before cutover

Alex —

Attaching the dry-run invite (ceremony-invite.ics), the preliminary evidence schema we will use to populate the bundle (evidence-schema.csv), and the custody checklist PDF. Highlights:

- Manual checkpoints we expect Stratus to own are labeled with [CUSTOMER ACTION]. Everything else is automated and will appear in the evidence manifest as an artifact with SHA256 and event_id.
- Operator attendance: operators sign via company SSO link; we also accept on-paper signatures scanned and added to the bundle if SSO is unavailable.
- KEK rotation: we will perform a staged rotation during the ceremony if you opt-in; otherwise we'll perform rotation post-cutover and include the rotation proof in the package.

Proposed dry-run slots:
- Tue 2027-07-06 09:00-10:00 PT
- Wed 2027-07-07 10:00-11:00 PT

Please confirm preferred slot and whether procurement wants the evidence notarized (procurement@stratushealth.com).

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
(attachments: custody-checklist.pdf, evidence-schema.csv, ceremony-invite.ics)
